It's the *codependence*, the impaired psychological condition that creates the need for religion, superstition, magical thinking, and the rest. That's the problem.

Hardly anyone recognizes that codependence is the problem because the condition is so universal. Most people are totally clueless about it, like small fry who don't know what water is. There is no "civilization" and no "State" without codependence. And when codependence is general, there is no avoiding them. 

"Civilization" is not a good thing, because it means none other than the "civilizing" of everyone by those who have monopolized violence and use it to "civilize" them. That's what the extortion of Law is all about.

comment.body: I was going to write a similar response to yours, questioning the author's assumption "that people really need something to worship", but your comment does a great job and renders mine repetitive/unnecessary. Thank you! Is anyone willing to openly discuss whether organized religions are not what they claim to be? Rather than a path to salvation or a means of finding the truth or a conduit to communion with a higher power, we need to entertain the thought that these religions instead are ideological shackles forged by man and sold to humanity under the guise of divinity. Dare we hope that our current societal turbulence might lead to an actual renaissance or do we instead accept the premise that man's nature is such that we are fated to perpetuate a hollow existence of hierarchical mistreatment of one another? Hoping for better.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
Toby, I hear you, but a new metaphysics won't help. 

The problem isn't intellectual or abstract. It's psychological. 

It turns out that people really need something to worship. There is where we need to dig. It turns out that's true -- but only for a certain, very distinct and easily identifiable type of people: codependents. 

Fix the codependency problem and the rest will come naturally, of its own. 

People really need something to worship because they're debilitated. Fully human people who make their own terms, form their own understandings, define themselves, and live accordingly don't need something to worship, because they experience life and themselves as integral to the whole. Not just talk about it, experience it, in what Csikszentmihalyi described as "flow". Living itself becomes their "form of worship”, not some artificial, ritualized human contrivance, not some more-than-natural experience or state (although I'm by no means knocking the latter, they're awesome.)

We were all fucked in head and heart 25 ways from Sunday throughout our development and maturation, stymieing both, and then we try to "fill the hole" and find answers that will get us what we want while we remain fucked. 

Not gonna happen. Gotta unfuck first.

I agree with much of that you say. It's been a fucking psycho-show ever since 2020.

But what you're actually criticizing aren't the libs/blues, nor are the MAGAs/reds just peachy. You're criticizing the the very "rule of law" and rule by elitist parasites, because the shit that's going on now, BOTH sides, is the inexorable, predictable result when you conceive of "rule" as the imposition of monopolized violence by an elitist class. It doesn't matter what color you paint it. Society founded on the monopolization and imposition of violence is evil, face paint or none. And when people praise evil as if their lives depended on it, you're looking at entire sick societies chock full of psychotics. No -- you can no more get good from evil than good water from a cesspool.

Invasion, conquest, terrorism, and genocide are its organic chemistry, its root and pith, and toxic, mortal horror is its fruit.
Its terrorism isn't a mistake -- it's the point.
Amurkins love that shit.

Edward Snowden blew the whistle on illegal mass surveillance by US authorities of their own population – and had to flee into permanent exile.

Julian Assange published details of the US military's war crimes – and spent years locked up in a high-security jail, denied his most basic rights.

Francesca Albanese has documented US government and corporate complicity in Israel's genocide in Gaza – and now, thanks to US sanctions, cannot have a bank account. As she explains here, anyone who deals with her faces up to 20 years in a US jail.

Notice a pattern? The US is the ultimate rogue state, destroying anyone who tries to hold it to account. It is utterly lawless. Its methods are those of the gangster, ruling a world where there are no police who can bring it to heel.

Trump is different only in that he no longer bothers to hide the fact.

comment.body:
There's a vast difference between respect and love, which is why they have no problem making “embryonic life" into cannon fodder when it matures. A rancher can have respect for a healthy herd of cattle -- even pride himself on it -- all the way to the slaughterhouse. 

There's also a huge chasm between someone who looks at a fetus as “embryonic life" instead of as their future baby child or grandchild. 



Apparently, Simone had not made the acquaintance of men who love babies.
